title: Transfer Stock
readerIntent: Move stock between governed locations with in-transit state and recovery.
priorKnowledge: Know source/destination, quantity/unit, permissions, and logistics references.
summary: A transfer coordinates paired movements and durable in-transit state rather than directly rewriting two balances.

sections.heading: Lifecycle
items: Reserve or deduct source according to policy and create in-transit state.
Dispatch, receive partially or fully, reject, cancel, or mark exception.
Create destination receipt and close only after reconciliation.
Use idempotency, revisions, audit, timeout, loss/damage compensation, and cache invalidation.
